title: The effect of phasic auditory alerting on visual perception
pdf_source: Google Scholar cached copy (centerforhjerneskade.dk, author repository)

focal_claim.text: Phasic auditory alertness affects visual perception by increasing the visual processing speed (p. 73.)

reported.statistic: Fitting the theory of visual attention (TVA) model to each participant (separately for each condition, cue/no cue), there was an increase in processing speed v, t(27) = 4.71, p < 0.001, dz = 0.89 when a 85 dB cue is presented prior to the letter, compared to when no cue was present.
